deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from the previous page. There is a truncated symmetric (pre-)simplicial structure:
- X_1 = {e_1}, a single point.
- X_2 carries an involution σ (an action of S_2) with a distinguished fixed point e_2.
- X_3 carries an action of S_3 = {1, ρ, ρ², σ_1, σ_2, σ_3}.
- There is a 'degeneracy' d: X_2 → X_3 and a 'face' p: X_3 → X_2. In the model case they are d(x,y) = (x,y,y) and p(x,y,z) = (x,y).
- The axioms (*) are: pd = id; pρd = constant map with value e_2; pρ²d = σ; σ_1 d = d; pσ_3 = σp.

A natural model of these axioms is the orbit structure of a transitive permutation group G acting on a set E. Then X_n = E^n/G, X_2 is the set of orbitals, σ is the pairing of an orbital with its transpose, and e_2 is the diagonal orbital. This is the combinatorics of coherent configurations / association schemes.

The previous page proves an injectivity statement: ρ^i d(ξ) = ρ^{i'} d(ξ') implies either (i ≡ i' mod 3 and ξ = ξ') or ξ = ξ' = e_2.

This page draws the consequence.
1. Let X_3' be the sub-S_3-set of X_3 generated by d(X_2). It has exactly one fixed point, e_3 = d(e_2).
2. Every other orbit has cardinality 3, with stabilizer conjugate to {1, σ_1} (because σ_1 d = d). These orbits correspond bijectively to X_2^* = X_2 \ {e_2}.
3. Hence, canonically, X_3' ≅ {e_3} ⊔ (S_3 ×_{⟨σ_1⟩} X_2^*), where ⟨σ_1⟩ acts trivially on X_2^*.
4. A marginal note says the formulas (*) therefore make the pre-simplicial data on X_3' completely explicit. X_3' is the 'degenerate' part of X_3.
5. What remains to be described is the complement X_3^* := X_3 \ X_3'. It is an S_3-set, together with the restriction p^* = p|X_3^* : X_3^* → X_2, which satisfies p^* σ_3 = σ p^*.
6. A further axiom is imposed or observed: (p, pρ): X_3 → X_2 × X_2 is surjective. Here pρ(x,y,z) = (y,z). So for every ξ, η in X_2 there is α in X_3 with pα = ξ and pρα = η. In the orbital model this is the fact that any two orbitals can be composed head-to-tail, which holds for transitive actions.

The next page computes the image of X_3' in X_2 × X_2. It is (X_2 × {e_2}) ∪ ({e_2} × X_2) ∪ graph(σ, id). It then asks when this image is all of X_2 × X_2, i.e. when no non-degenerate triples are needed. The answer is |X_2| ≤ 2 with σ trivial, the analogue of rank ≤ 2 (2-transitivity). The page thus serves a classification of such 'symmetric 3-truncated' structures: split off the degenerate part and describe the free remainder.
errors: No mathematical error. The orbit decomposition follows correctly from the previous page's injectivity lemma, and the stabilizer of d(ξ) is exactly ⟨σ_1⟩ for ξ ≠ e_2, giving orbits of size 3. The phrase rendered 'dans l'opposition régulière' cannot literally be 'régulière': these orbits are S_3/⟨σ_1⟩, not regular orbits. It is presumably a misreading or slip.

The boxed relation p^*σ_3 = σp^* is just the restriction of an axiom in (*). On its own it does not determine the S_3-set X_3^* or the remaining face data, so the description of X_3^* is still open at this point.

ideas.what: Decomposition of the degenerate part of the S_3-set X_3 as {e_3} ⊔ S_3 ×_{⟨σ_1⟩} X_2^*
ideas.modern_name: degenerate/non-degenerate splitting of a (truncated) symmetric simplicial set; induced G-sets
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard (Eilenberg–Zilber-type lemma for symmetric simplicial sets; induced representations)

ideas.what: Axiomatics with X_1 a point, X_2 an involutive set with a fixed diagonal element, X_3 an S_3-set with faces and degeneracies, and (p, pρ) surjective
ideas.modern_name: orbit structure of a transitive permutation group: orbitals, paired orbitals, coherent configurations / association schemes (truncated symmetric nerve)
ideas.usually_credited_to: D. G. Higman (coherent configurations, ~1970); Bose–Mesner; Wielandt / Sims (orbitals)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a symmetric-simplicial (S_n-equivariant face/degeneracy) axiomatization whose model is the orbits of a transitive group on E, E², E³. This is a categorical reformulation of coherent configurations / orbitals, framed within his 'topos stratifié' project. A presheaf-on-finite-sets viewpoint on association schemes is not standard in that literature, but the content on this page is elementary.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor. It hints at reading stratified/oligomorphic structures as symmetric simplicial presheaves (cf. 'type spaces' of ω-categorical structures as FI-sets / Schanuel topos). That is a link already made, in other terms, in modern work on orbit-finite sets.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine equivariant bookkeeping, splitting off the degenerate part of an S_3-set. The only mildly interesting aspect is the implicit orbital/coherent-configuration model inside a topos-theoretic project, which is not developed here.
transcription_corrections: Marginal note reads approximately: 'et on a une explicitation des structures pré-simpliciales sur X_3' via les formules (*), et des [données] correspondantes ...'.
'qui s'exprime' is likely 'Reste à exprimer' (introducing X_3^* := X_3 \ X_3').
'dans l'opposition régulière de S_3' is unclear; probably 'dans la représentation ...' (the orbits are of type S_3/⟨σ_1⟩).
Under X_3' the brace reads 'S_3 · d(X_2)'.
In the last line ξ is written with Greek xi and η with eta: 'pour ξ, η ∈ X_2, ∃α ∈ X_3 avec pα = ξ, pρα = η'.
